corpus.source: Original frozen TSG complete TEXT_CORPUS.json, not the later difference-text corpus
corpus.instruction: Represent this energy forecasting context, preserving asset identity, observation availability, current operating state, and the direction and magnitude of changes.
corpus.tokenizer: Pinned Qwen3-Embedding-8B tokenizer; same token IDs and official terminal token for both models; no chat template
corpus.pooling: last valid token of final layer, FP32 thenL2

static.estimator: FP64 mean of each encoder normalized TRAIN vectors per task/asset, FP64 L2normalize centroid then cast onceFP32
static.scope: Same asset vector for all TRAIN/VAL windows; no labels orVAL fitting

training.loss: equal-task TRAIN-mean-absolute-scale masked Huber1 plus1e-4 pre-strength branch energy

selection.metric: complete four-task VAL asset-macro NMAE mean

success.primary: Encoder main effect, dynamic/static effect within each encoder, interaction on full four-task meanVALNMAE; original unified selection
success.practical: Embeddingdynamic at least1percent lower meanVALNMAE than ordinarydynamic and0.5percent lower than embeddingstatic; at least3tasks favorableNMAE is stability evidence, never a selector
success.metrics: All16 and fullTRAINVAL; no requirement all16 win; report large task losses
success.mechanism: Correct vs matched wrong-window frozen forecast after selection, not gate/geometry only
success.significance: 2027 exploratory; paired temporal-origin blocks, keep assets at same origin together; finalmultiseed requires separate authorization
success.failure: Keep negative results; after2nonimproving rounds diagnose and read primary sources before successor; no blindLR/pooling/weight grid
